description: Next-generation spectral film engine. Installs side-by-side with PhotoChemist 2.x.
_tagComment: This entry shares the PhotoChemist-OFX release repo with the 2.x line (docs/plugins/photochemist/). releaseTagPattern pins it to v3.* releases; every 3.0 release is a GitHub prerelease, so prereleaseAsStable makes the newest v3 beta this entry's stable.json (the manager app requires a stable.json for every index entry). Anchored assetPatterns are exact — v3 CI publishes exactly PhotoChemist3Beta-macOS.zip / PhotoChemist3Beta-windows-cuda.zip / PhotoChemist3Beta-linux-cuda.zip per release.
_demoComment: The CURRENT watermarked demo is a build of THIS line (3.0 beta), so it lives here rather than on the 2.x entry: it installs as PhotoChemist3Beta.ofx.bundle / com.dec18studios.PhotoChemist3Beta, matching the assetRules below — which matters because apply_demo_override() in installer.rs swaps only downloadUrl/sha256/version and takes bundleName from those rules. sha256 is resolved live from the demo release's asset.digest by the generator (the demo tag is delete+recreated on every build, so a pinned hash goes stale immediately); pin version + downloadUrl only, and add a sha256 under an asset only to force a manual override. The demo release always carries the CLEAN marketing version — CI strips -beta/-alpha/-rc from the source tag — so a photochemist-v3.0.0-beta.N tag publishes demo v3.0.0. Keep the explicit /releases/download/<tag>/ URL form: the generator's sha resolver asserts on it, and a /releases/latest/download/ URL fails that parse. The 2.x entry (docs/plugins/photochemist/) deliberately keeps its OWN demo block pinned to the last 2.x demo, v2.7.0 — the cards are independent, so that is not a leftover to clean up. The website offers only the 3.0 demo.
